subject: Renewal pricing: uplift options and co-term proposal
messages:
From: Avery Lowe <procurement@nexerahealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nexera Finance <finance@nexerahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Usage surge + mid-contract capacity ask

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from procurement — our infra usage has spiked significantly this quarter (see attached Nexera_Q2_usage_report.csv). We’re seeing roughly a 2.8x increase in inference tokens compared to our Q1 average and I need to understand options for adding capacity mid-contract.

Current renewal runs through 2026-10-31 and we’d prefer not to change the renewal date, but we may be open to co-term if it reduces unit cost. Key asks: a) pricing for an immediate uplift (start retroactive to 2026-07-01 if possible), b) whether any temporary credits or promo discounts apply for this burst, and c) lead time for execution (procurement needs an updated quote/PO instructions).

I’ve looped in finance on the PO workflow. Can you send options and a preferred recommendation?

Thanks,
Avery Lowe
Procurement Manager, Nexera Health
attachments: Nexera_Q2_usage_report.csv (text/csv, stub)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-07-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Usage surge + mid-contract capacity ask — need pricing options

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Avery's note. They’ve ballooned usage and procurement is asking for two things: immediate uplift (ideally retro to Jul 1) and guidance on co-term vs. short-term burst credit.

Quick context: account NEX-4537, renewal 2026-10-31, current commit 18M tokens/mo. They’re requesting +35M tokens/mo starting now.

Can you outline 1) short-term uplift pricing (pro-rata, immediate start), 2) co-term offer (annualize mid-contract, discount bands), and 3) recommended commercial to send (we need something procurement can route through finance). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

CCing Rishi for finance implications.

-Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Usage surge + mid-contract capacity ask — proposal options

Thanks Steph — read the usage file. Two pragmatic options that balance speed to delivery and margin:

Option A — Burst/Uplift (fastest)
- Add 35M tokens/mo effective 2026-07-01 (retro).
- Charge: pro-rated monthly at $0.0045 per token for the uplift portion.
- One-time setup fee waived.
- Temporary credit: 15% off uplift charges for first 2 months to smooth onboarding.
- No change to renewal date.

Option B — Mid-contract co-term + committed uplift (recommended if they want lower unit cost)
- Convert uplift into a committed add-on for remainder of the term and co-term to 2027-01-31 (aligns renewal).
- Annualized commitment = additional 35M tokens/mo for remaining 6 months (prorated to term) then 12-month renewal at new band.
- Pricing: $0.0037 per token (22% discount off uplift rate) if they commit and co-term.
- Apply 5% account-level credit to acknowledge mid-term switch.

Implementation notes:
- Option A gets them live same week; Option B requires DocuSign amendment and sign-off from Finance (~5 business days).
- I attached a draft quote (proposal_nexera_optionA_v1.pdf) you can send to procurement.
- HubSpot deal updated with both options and recommended pick = Option B (longer-term retention + better unit economics).

Let me know if they require uplift to be retroactive to Jul 1 — we can honor retro start for Option A and for Option B as a one-time billing adjustment, subject to PO.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposal_nexera_optionA_v1.pdf (application/pdf, stub)
From: Avery Lowe <procurement@nexerahealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nexera Finance <finance@nexerahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Usage surge + mid-contract capacity ask — proposal options

Stephanie,

Thanks — appreciate the clear options. Procurement preference is to minimize manual mid-term billing complexity; Nexera is willing to co-term if that delivers meaningful unit-cost savings. Tentatively they like Option B (co-term + committed uplift) but we need formal language for legal and PO. Two follow-ups: 1) Can you provide a short amendment (1–2 pages) that we can attach to our PO? 2) Can the co-term be to 2027-01-31 (your example) and have the pricing effective 2026-07-01 (retroactive to start of their surge)? Procurement requires PO instructions (format, remit address, billing contact).

Also please confirm whether we need to push invoices for the retro period or if Redwood will credit the first invoice as an adjustment. Attached is our PDF on PO workflow (PO_Instructions.pdf).

Avery Lowe
Procurement Manager, Nexera Health

Team — summarizing so we can move to DocuSign:

Agreed path with Nexera (they’ve verbally accepted Option B):
- Co-term to 2027-01-31; pricing band $0.0037/token for the committed uplift of +35M tokens/mo.
- Effective start: 2026-07-01 (retroactive). We will apply a billing adjustment for Jul charges and include that on the first post-amendment invoice.
- Additional 5% account credit applied to acknowledge mid-term change.

Action items:
- Marissa: please draft a 1–2 page amendment (amendment_draft_nexera.docx attached) formatted for DocuSign; include start date, token bands, and billing adjustment note.
- Rishi: confirm accounting treatment for retro credit and whether we need a special invoice run.
- Ben: prepare final pricing table and attach DocuSign link to the HubSpot deal.

I’ll send the draft amendment to Avery and CC Nexera Finance once we have Marissa’s draft. Related links: HubSpot deal https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 and DocuSign placeholder https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example-docu-sign-proposal

-Steph
